capabilities: wrap text in custom underline, highlighter, and spoiler markers
create presets with their own marker, color, opacity, and thickness
restyle Obsidian's built-in ==highlight== syntax and bold text
toggle markers with commands, hotkeys, or the mobile toolbar
align images left or right with #left/#right link suffixes
disambiguation: Not just underline styling; it also adds highlighter presets, click-to-reveal spoilers, bold recoloring, and image alignment.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; installation is manual (no community plugin store instructions beyond manual/source steps).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in underline syntax, so users must type <u>text</u>, and the built-in highlight color cannot be customized.
summary: Formatting plugin that adds underline, highlighter, and spoiler text via simple markers like ++text++ instead of HTML tags.
